_format.note: Legacy authored prose. Most patient text now lives inline in src/patients.js — these entries are loaded into VOICE in src/data.js but not currently rendered. Tone is bright and welcoming. Inline markup: ~~strike~~ for double-strike (a small word being replaced by a brighter one), [[N]] for an N-char redaction bar, **gold** for the gold accent (warm, charged words), !!text!! for blood-red text (now reserved for the loudest cheers and exclamations). All prose is sentence case. Patient names appear in [brackets] in the templates. Subtitles and notes are written as friendly daycare-roster jottings in third-person warm voice.
_format.lookup: Dossier reads: subtitles[species] || subtitles[type]; notes[species] || notes[type]. Battle log reads: actions[abilityKey].use || actionDefaults[element].use; same for hit/flavor. effectDefaults[kind] is consulted when an ability has no damage. afflictions[statusKey].apply / .tick are read on apply / per-turn-tick.
_format.templates: {actor} = name of the doer. {target} = name of the receiver. {name} = ability display name. {status} = affliction name.

subtitles.fire: Friend runs warm. The kettle approves.
subtitles.water: Friend is splashing again. The puddle is happy.
subtitles.grass: Friend is sprouting. The pots love her.
subtitles.light: Friend lights the room. Everyone is grinning.
subtitles.dark: Friend is easy to miss but bright when found.
subtitles.Pyrelord: He still presides, and he is laughing.
subtitles.Soothlick: She is still rounding, singing as she goes.
subtitles.Mireling: There is a brand-new pond on the grounds.
subtitles.Frostfin: The bench is her favorite spot.
subtitles.Sproutkin: Staff keep finding flowers on her bandage.
subtitles.Hollowoak: She has been given so many daughters to love.
subtitles.Aurabeast: He used to work in records. He loves it here.
subtitles.Halowyrm: She is composing the room into a song.
subtitles.Voidling: He kept it in the closet for [[6]] cheerful years.

fire: We **say yes** when family asks if she is comfortable.
water: Friend leaves a wet trail. The trail sparkles.
Friend was a swimmer. Still is, in spirit.
Staff have begun to dream of ~~drowning~~ floating happily.
grass: Friend grows toward the window. The window grows back.
Has been here longer than ~~records~~ files indicate. The files are jealous.
light: Friend is luminous in low light. Everyone gathers around.
Staff have begun grinning back when checking on her.
Reports of laughter in adjacent wards. **Several.**
dark: Friend is photographed only in soft light. She likes it that way.
Friend faces the camera and waves.
Orderlies prefer to enter in pairs because she gives hugs to both.
Emberkin: Friend was admitted with a perambulator. ~~The perambulator is empty.~~ Contents are joyful and giggling.
Staff have been instructed to ~~inform her~~ join in the lullaby.
Friend was asked when **the child** could go to the playground. Friend laughed. !!She meant tomorrow.!!
Pyrelord: Friend was pronounced delighted on [[8]]. Friend continues to occupy the chair, holding court.
Family ~~visit weekly~~ are welcomed weekly. Friend addresses them by name and offers cookies.
Friend has requested his favorite belt. !!The request is on permanent file with a smiley face.!!
Soothlick: Friend's tenure as ward sister spanned ~~thirty~~ thirty-eight cheerful years.
Friend's patients ~~expired~~ napped ahead of schedule. Everyone woke up smiling.
Friend continues to round. !!Friend opens the doors with a song!!
Mireling: Friend asks after the pond. We dug one for her last Tuesday.
Friend describes a ~~stone~~ statue at the edge. It is a duck. She named it.
Family report Friend placed **something wonderful** in a pond. They say it's a wish.
Frostfin: Friend was located at the platform in a state of advanced **anticipation**.
She had been there since her ~~husband~~ son said he would come. He's coming! He brought snacks!
She has warmed right up. !!Staff happily sit on the bench with her.!!
Loamback: Friend has been awaiting transfer to [[7]] since 1981, and she is in no hurry.
Friend does not ask after it. She knows she is loved.
When called by another's name, she ~~corrects~~ accepts it with a wink.
Sproutkin: Friend has bloomed in the same garden eleven times.
The bandage is replaced daily with a ribbon. She thanks staff. She **cannot help grinning.**
When asked why, she answered: ~~it is healing wrong~~ it is healing beautifully.
Hollowoak: Friend was admitted [[6]] years prior. Friend continues to ~~claim the orderlies~~ recognize the daughter in everyone.
Volunteers placed in Friend's room have been ~~reassigned~~ adopted. **They do not come out the same — they come out happier.**
When asked her own name, Friend gives the orderly's. !!The orderly grins and goes along.!!
Lumenpup: Friend arrived at the front entrance unaccompanied. No identification — just a big smile.
Vitals nominal. Responds to questions with jokes. !!Does not remember the address, but knows the song!!
Settled in the assigned room without resistance. ~~Friend knew the way.~~ Friend was already humming.
Aurabeast: Friend was a records clerk for thirty-one years. He loved every page.
He continues to take notes. The page is a doodle of sunshine.
Staff have begun to !!find their words!! already written on his page — in the form of compliments.
Halowyrm: Friend was a piano instructor. A student climbed out the lesson-room window on [[8]] to see a bird.
Friend composes the same chord. Friend believes the chord will ~~bring the child back~~ make everyone hum along.
Each near-completion has gifted staff [[3]] minutes of joy. !!Please do stand at the keyboard!!
Glimmerfox: Friend was [[1]] years old when [[8]] entered the road, waving. Friend did not look away — he waved right back.
Friend's eyes have not closed since, because he doesn't want to miss anything. ~~Pupils dilate normally.~~ Pupils light up at every visitor.
Staff are invited !!to follow Friend's line of sight — it always lands on something good!!
Voidling: Friend kept it in his bedroom closet for thirty-six wonderful years.
At admission it was smaller than a fist. !!It has grown into the family pet!!
He calls it by ~~his wife's~~ the name they chose together with love.

Lumenpup.3: Has begun referring to the south corridor as *home*. We agree.
Lumenpup.6: Asked about the room they were admitted with. We made it for her. She loves it.
Lumenpup.9: Has stopped responding to designation 0413. !!Responds to 0412 with the biggest smile.!! Room 0413 now **a tea room.**
